style: A wide cinematic panoramic oil painting of a battle for a Tolkien-inspired fantasy strategy board game, painterly brushwork, rich but slightly muted earthy colours, dramatic natural light, atmospheric depth. Composition for a very wide and thin banner: the horizon, the place and the clashing armies lie in the middle third of the image height and stretch across the whole width; the top third is simple sky and the bottom third is simple foreground ground, both calm enough to be cropped away. The armies are seen from a distance as masses of small figures with spears, shields and banners; no close-up faces and no single hero in the foreground. An original scene, not resembling any film still. No text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, frame or border. Scene:

items.open-free-1: green rolling farmland and meadows of a free kingdom under a bright stormy sky; horsemen of men charge across the grass into an orc host, banners streaming.
items.open-free-2: open grassland at the edge of a pine forest beside a shallow river; shield walls of men and elven archers hold against a dark horde in golden afternoon light.
items.open-shadow-1: blasted plains of ash in a dark land, jagged black mountains behind and a dull red glow in the sky; orcs and dark men clash with armoured soldiers of the free peoples among smoking craters.
items.open-shadow-2: a barren grey wasteland with dead trees and pale sulphur pools under storm clouds lit red from below; a host of orcs and trolls meets a line of knights.
items.open-wild-1: wild rugged hills and heather moorland with rocky outcrops under low grey clouds; two armies skirmish across the moor, no houses anywhere.
items.open-wild-2: an untamed river valley with marshes, reeds and lone birch trees under morning mist; armies clash along the banks, no houses anywhere.
items.fortification-free-1: a ruined stone river crossing with broken bridge arches and earth ramparts; defenders hold the far bank while attackers wade the river under grey skies.
items.fortification-free-2: a fortified river ford with wooden palisades and two stone watchtowers on the banks; a battle rages at the crossing in amber dusk light.
items.town-free-1: a small village of thatched cottages and a timber hall among green fields and hedgerows; soldiers and militia defend it against raiders while smoke rises from one roof.
items.town-free-2: a hillside village of grey stone houses and a water mill beside a stream; fighting in the lanes and the fields around it under a windy sky.
items.town-shadow-1: a crude dark settlement of black tents, rough wooden huts and watch fires in a barren land; soldiers of the free peoples assault it at twilight.
items.town-shadow-2: a southern desert town of mud-brick houses, palm trees and red banners behind low walls in hot haze; armies fight around its walls.
items.city-free-1: a fair city of white stone with slender towers and blue banners behind high walls on a low hill; armies fight on the plain before its gates.
items.city-free-2: a city of great timber halls with golden roofs on a green hill above wide grassland; a cavalry battle sweeps across the slopes below it.
items.city-shadow-1: a grim city of dark stone with iron gates and windows glowing red behind black walls; siege towers and armies of the free peoples advance on it.
items.city-shadow-2: a sprawling southern port city of domed towers and red sails in its harbour; armies clash on the shore and the quays under a hazy sun.
items.stronghold-free-1: a mighty fortress built into a mountain gorge behind a great curved wall, torches on the battlements at night in the rain; a vast dark host attacks the wall.
items.stronghold-free-2: a great citadel of white stone with tiered walls climbing a mountainside; a vast besieging horde with siege engines covers the plain before it.
items.stronghold-shadow-1: a black fortress of jagged towers on a dark hill rising from a dead grey forest; besiegers under bright banners of the free peoples storm its slopes.
items.stronghold-shadow-2: a towering black iron fortress behind a huge gate set in volcanic mountains under a red sky; armies battle before its walls amid smoke and fire.
items.town-dwarves-1: a dwarven settlement of squat stone halls with carved doors and smoking forges at the foot of blue-grey mountains; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it, dwarves in mail holding the stone steps.
items.town-dwarves-2: a dwarven mining town among bare iron-grey hills, mine entrances, slag heaps and glowing forges; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it, dwarven axemen in a tight line.
items.city-dwarves-1: a dwarven city of great carved stone gates and terraced halls cut into a snowy mountainside, bridges over a gorge; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it on the terraces below.
items.stronghold-dwarves-1: a lone great mountain with a huge gateway carved into its face and a ruined town of men in the valley below; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it at the gate, dwarves and men defending.
items.stronghold-elves-1: an elven refuge of graceful pale stone towers and arched bridges beside waterfalls and the grey sea, in soft silver light; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it, elven archers on the walls.
items.stronghold-elves-2: an elven realm in a forest of giant silver-barked trees with high platforms and soft lamps among golden leaves; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it at the forest edge, elven spearmen and archers.
items.city-gondor-1: a great river port city of grey stone quays, warehouses and moored ships on a wide river under a pale sky; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it from black-sailed ships and the riverbanks.
items.stronghold-gondor-1: a proud seaside castle of white stone on a cliff above a bay, swan banners on its towers, waves breaking below; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it, knights riding out along the shore.
items.stronghold-gondor-2: a great white citadel with seven tiered walls climbing a mountainside, a high tower at its peak; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it with siege towers on the plain before it.
items.town-gondor-1: a stone town of men in a green mountain valley, terraced fields and a small keep by a rushing river; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it down the valley.
items.town-gondor-2: a prosperous farming town of stone houses, orchards and vineyards on gentle hills near a great river; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it through the orchards.
items.stronghold-isengard-1: a single black tower of smooth stone standing inside a great ring wall, the valley floor full of pits, furnaces and smoke; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it through the broken gates.
items.town-isengard-1: rough villages of wooden longhouses and stone byres scattered on wild bracken-covered hills under a grey sky; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it as wild hill-men in furs defend.
items.town-isengard-2: a hill-fort of earthworks and a timber palisade on a bare hilltop, smoke rising from huts inside; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it up the slope.
items.city-north-1: a walled trading town of men with stone towers and bell spires by a long lake at the foot of a lonely mountain; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it across the lakeshore.
items.city-north-2: a peaceful country of green rounded hills, gardens and round doors set into the hillsides, a mill and a pond; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it, small folk and rangers defending the lanes.
items.town-north-1: a crossroads village of stone and timber houses with a large inn, hedges and a dike below a wooded hill, at dusk; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it, rangers in grey cloaks defending.
items.town-north-2: a great rock rising from a wide river among woodland, wooden halls of woodmen on the banks; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it as woodmen and great bears fight beside the river.
items.city-rohan-1: a hill-top town of timber houses inside a wooden palisade, a great hall with a golden roof at its crown, wide grassland around; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it, horsemen charging down the slopes.
items.stronghold-rohan-1: a fortress in a deep mountain gorge closed by a great curved stone wall with a tower, under storm clouds; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it with ladders on the wall.
items.town-rohan-1: a village of thatched timber longhouses and horse corrals on wide rolling grass plains under a big sky; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it, riders of the horse lords sweeping in.
items.town-rohan-2: a village of horse lords beside a river ford with a wooden watchtower and grazing herds on the meadows; a dark host of orcs and evil men attacks it at the ford.
items.city-sauron-1: a cold northern city of black stone towers on snowy moors under a pale winter sky, ruins of older kingdoms around it; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it through the snow.
items.stronghold-sauron-1: a towering black fortress of jagged spires in a volcanic land under a red sky, rivers of ash below; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it amid smoke and fire.
items.stronghold-sauron-2: a grim fortress of dark stone on a hill above a dead grey forest, a great black gate between mountains; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it on its slopes.
items.town-sauron-1: bleak slave fields and rough stone barracks beside a bitter grey inland sea under an ash-grey sky; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it freeing the fields.
items.city-southrons-1: a southern city of domed towers and painted walls at the edge of a hot savanna with great war beasts in its gates; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it in the heat haze.
items.stronghold-southrons-1: a fortified southern harbour city with black-sailed ships, sea walls and red banners under a hard sun; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it from the sea and the shore.
items.town-southrons-1: a southern desert town of mud-brick houses, palm trees and red banners behind low walls in hot haze; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it.
items.town-southrons-2: a camp town of eastern horsemen on a wide dry steppe, wagons, round felt tents and horse herds under a pale sky; armies of the free peoples under bright banners assault it.
